lines: Book-learned vidyā thus said in Siddha-doctrine; then who but in book-obtained even in mantra power know.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pustakādhītavidyāścetyuktaṃ siddhāmate tataḥ ye tu pustakalabdhe@pi mantre vīryaṃ prajānate
